title: Bubbles Co-op. Part 1: primary films
brief_description: A compilation of primary school children’s films which were screened at Melbourne University “Bubbles Co-op” Film Festival. Films shown include a science fiction drama, a social documentary and several animated films. Suitable for Upper Primary-Upper Secondary level students. No other credits available.
